Coram : HEMANT GUPTA*, SUDHANSHU DHULIA
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 – Motor accident resulting in death of a person – Compensation claim on his behalf by his wife, his son and his mother – Accident occurred when deceased was riding on a three-wheeler with his brother – The vehicle was being driven by respondent no. Tribunal was of the opinion that the accident did occur due to the rash and negligent driving by driver of the three-wheeler and fixed the liability on the insurance company – Total amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal was Rs.4,33,000/- – Appeal – High Court awarded
Decision Date : 14-10-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6818/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
